title: RequestError missing std::error::Error impl
description: RequestError has only #[derive(Debug)], no Display or Error impl. Library users who want to use ? to chain RequestError with other errors (e.g., in axum handlers returning Result<Response, Box<dyn Error>>) cannot do so. The From<JmapError> for RequestError already half-commits to error-propagation ergonomics; missing Error impl is an incomplete story. Fix: add Display (e.g., 'JMAP request error {type}: {description}') and impl std::error::Error.
